hint.set-memory: Sets the memory limit on every selected app. A raise is checked against quota, and the review shows each app's old and new value.
hint.set-cpu: Sets the CPU limit in cores on every selected app. A raise is checked against quota, and the review shows each app's old and new value.
hint.set-env: Sets one environment variable on every selected app. Apps where the name comes from a secret, vault or database reference are skipped.
